content:
erica_ae: Heads up — Summit Financial exec just flagged the pilot as blocking renewal unless we confirm throughput SLA + BYO KMS import + HSM attestation. Need ops + security + SEs to triage ASAP.

matt_solutions: On it. What exact throughput + latency numbers do they want? Timeline for canary/fallback?

erica_ae: They asked for 50 QPS sustained, p95 <= 150ms for ~2k token gen. CTO wants exec signoff by EOD tomorrow. Also called out zero-knowledge KMS import and FIPS/HSM attestation.

lia_se: 50 QPS p95 150ms is feasible with Dedicated (4x A100) + model pinning + quantization + prefix caching. I can sketch a suggested config.

nora_eng: I can run a canary config: batch_size=8, kv-cache=on, kernel selection tuned. Running perf sim now.

devon_security: Security note: BYO KMS + HSM attestation will require vendor validation. Need to confirm which HSM (AWS CloudHSM vs on-prem PKCS#11). Also customer will ask for SOC2 + custom questionnaire answers.

erica_ae: They already sent a questionnaire. Snippet: "Do you support FIPS 140-2 validated HSMs? Do you provide per-tenant key isolation? Describe key import flow and zero-knowledge attestation."

ops-bot: Deploy queued: dedicated-cluster-cobalt-canary -> requested by nora_eng. status: queued.

nora_eng: Perf sim (local): 50 QPS, 2k tokens: tps=55, p50=80ms, p95=140ms, mem=86GB with batch=8. Will post raw numbers.

lia_se: Pricing note: For Dedicated commit we can offer 20% off on 12-mo reserved. Also propose burst-to-hosted fallback at ~60% hosted cost for overflow. Need finance OK for exec offer.

matt_solutions: @devon_security will you take the questionnaire? @rebecca_finance can you confirm we can offer the discount?

rebecca_finance: I can approve the 20% for standard 12-mo reserved if sales commits to baseline usage. I'll need the baseline numbers and expected burst hours.

devon_security: I'll draft answers by EOD. Quick question: do they want us to import keys into our environment or just connect to their KMS? Erica?

erica_ae: They prefer key import with zero-knowledge attestation. Legal will want a "no-key-retention" addendum. Looping in legal.

carl_legal: We can draft the addendum. Need a technical flow for imports and confirmation of no-persistence. Send me a short sample clause.

nora_eng: Sample deploy command for runbook:
```
redwood deploy --cluster dedicated-cobalt --model pinned:v1 --batch=8 --kv-cache on --kms-import true
```

erica_ae: :thumbsup: Can someone assemble a 1-pg runbook for exec summary (risks, mitigation, rollback)? Need it for the bridge.

lia_se: I'll assemble runbook with rollback steps and routing fallback to hosted (policy snippet).

matt_solutions: Plan: runbook + security Qs + pricing addendum in ~10 hours. I'll set a 10:00am bridge tomorrow with Summit CTO and our exec.

erica_ae: Confirmed. If we deliver addendum + answers + perf numbers legal should push signoff.

ops-bot: Deploy status update: dedicated-cluster-cobalt-canary -> in-progress (1/3 nodes ready).

nora_eng: Canary update: under a 70 QPS stress test p95 = 160ms. Pushed batch->10 improves p95 but increases p50. Tuning kernel selection might help latency tail.

devon_security: Heads-up: HSM attestation timelines vary by vendor; assume 48–72h to complete validation. Be transparent with customer.

erica_ae: I'll tell Summit CTO we anticipate attestation up to 72h, aiming for 48h. Bridge at 10:00am set by matt. Thanks everyone — please drop docs/answers into the thread as they land. :heart:
